d: A resident of Gurugram's Trump Towers has accused developer M3M India of effectively putting him and his family under 'house arrest' after allegedly denying them direct lift access from their 36th-floor apartment. Varun Suhag, who paid Rs 6.68 crore for the apartment, claims he struggled for months to get the lift call button activated. He also alleged that workers were stopped from entering his apartment to install curtains, raising concerns over his family's privacy.
